description: This file implements the AdbHandler class for managing ADB socket communication, including setting up the socket, reading data, and handling messages within the WebRTC streaming context.

classes.name: AdbHandler
classes.description: Handles ADB socket communication, including setup, reading, and message handling.

methods.name: AdbHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ADB socket and starts the read loop thread.

methods.name: ~AdbHandler
methods.description: Destructor that signals shutdown and joins the read thread.

methods.name: ReadLoop
methods.description: Continuously reads data from the ADB socket and forwards it to the client.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Sends a message through the ADB socket, handling partial writes and errors.
